meta.notes: All source PDFs are image scans with no text layer. Figures were transcribed by reading zoomed page images, with Windows built-in OCR used only as a cross-check; none comes from OCR alone. Checks passed for every published value: GF + SEF = Total on each row; Local Sources = Tax + Non-Tax; Income = Local + External; net operating income = income - expenditures; net increase in funds = net operating income + loan and other non-income receipts - capital outlay - debt principal - other non-operating spending; ending cash = beginning cash + net increase - prior-year payables + advance RPT payment (for the periods where those rows were read); loans: released - principal paid = outstanding; SEF receipts, disbursements and balance; LDRRMF available - utilization = unutilized; 2020-2022 budget tax + other revenue = total income. Each SRE period is cumulative year to date and is taken from the document header, not the file name (2020 file = Q4 2019, 2021 file = Q4 2020, 2022 file = Q4 2021, 2023 file = Q4 2022 and Q2-Q4 2023, 2024 file = Q1-Q4 2024, 2025 file = Q1-Q3 2025, 2026 file = Q1 2026). Other quarters are not in the files and are absent. null means not read reliably or not shown: Q4 2020 tax revenue SEF and total; the budget ordinance amount for 2020-2022; income split for 2023-2026 (only the ordinance amount was read); LDRRMF utilization and unutilized balance for May, July and September 2025 (the 2025 LDRRMF file ends in September). Budget total income excludes the beginning cash balance, as printed on LBP Form 7. Loan statements cover Q1-Q3 2025 and Q1 2026 only (no Q4 2025 report on the portal). Annual Procurement Plan, bid results and GAD report are not included. Amounts are in Philippine pesos. Source oddities published as printed are logged in docs/data/SOURCES.md (discrepancy log 9-13).
